evidence_strength: high that the operating point differs; high for N29/breaker connectivity and RON non-dominance; insufficient to map the flow difference to one editable model item or exact N29-to-DFIG transfer cause
recommended_next_step: Trace Stage4/Stage9 initialization and full pre-fault branch-flow differences to a single source/load/network initialization item; also recover N29/DFIG-PCC voltage observability or complete compiled mapping. Do not tune parameters or repeat Run now.
paper_sequence_implication: Stage9 remains a validated line-first-trip protection subchain, not a DFIG-before-line-trip paper-like chain.
claim_boundary: No PNNL thermal-rating, protection-setting, coordination, second-trip, natural-cascade, or strict-paper-reproduction claim.
